title: Ephemerons: avoid the quadratic garbage-collection blowup on all GC cycles except the first one

target.summary: Removing `ephe_next_round()` from `mark()` causes `num_domains_to_mark` to be decremented before requesting the next ephemeron round. This creates a data race where another domain can observe `num_domains_to_mark == 0` and treat marking as complete, resulting in a GC deadlock.
notes: faulty statement: deferred call to ephe_next_round() added after mark() decrements num_domains_to_mark
